transcript: ˌiː juː ˌiː iː eɪ ˈsɪtɪzən
definitions: A person who holds citizenship of a country that is a member of the European Union or the European Economic Area.
An individual entitled to the rights and freedoms afforded by EU/EEA law, including free movement within member states.
examples: As an EU/EEA citizen, she could work in Germany without a visa.
The new policy affects every EU/EEA citizen residing in the UK.
He proudly declared himself an EU/EEA citizen.
